one_liner.zh: 提取哔哩哔哩视频文稿、评论、弹幕并按需抓帧总结
one_liner.en: Extract Bilibili transcripts, comments, danmaku and keyframes

accounts: Bilibili account only for login-required subtitles or account login

external_services.purpose: Fetch video metadata, subtitles, comments, and playback streams for extraction.
Optional Bijian ASR transcription when videos lack subtitle tracks.
QR login and polling for Bilibili credentials.

local: Node.js 18+ and FFmpeg are documented prerequisites; FFmpeg is used for downloads, audio conversion, and frame capture.
Optional local whisper.cpp or sherpa-onnx binaries and model files for offline transcription.
Optional local Ollama or llama.cpp vision endpoint; frames and temporary transcript/cache files are stored locally.

completeness.reason: Extraction, login, health checks, transcript fallbacks, and frame processing are implemented; extraction supports only video part 1.

code.reason: Modules separate extraction, formatting, frame selection, login, and environment checks; channel failures are generally isolated.

docs.reason: README explains installation, compatibility, setup, workflow, and configuration with examples and limitations.

maintenance.reason: The snapshot records 26 commits and a push on 2026-10-23, within 30 days of this analysis.

tests.reason: A unit test file covers pure parsing, formatting, and frame-selection helpers; no CI is present.
